confirmation-email.description: Thank you for registering at Nova Academy! To complete the process, please confirm your email by clicking the button below.
confirmation-email.ignoreNote: If you did not register, please ignore this email.
confirmation-email.subject: Email Confirmation
confirmation-email.warning: Confirm your email in the settings to enable the ability to make purchases.

course-purchase.description: Thank you for your purchase and trust in Nova Academy! We hope this investment brings you great benefits.
course-purchase.ignoreNote: If you have any questions, please feel free to contact our support team.
course-purchase.purchaseNote: We are delighted to inform you that you have successfully purchased the course or workshop:
course-purchase.subject: Thank you for your purchase! Access to your course is now open 🔑

teacher-payout.description: We are pleased to inform you that your withdrawal request has been processed. The funds have been successfully transferred to your account.
teacher-payout.gratitude: Thank you for your contribution and professionalism in working with the Nova Academy platform!
teacher-payout.ignoreNote: In the analytics section, you can check the status of your account and payment details.
teacher-payout.subject: Payment Confirmed 💸

login-code.subject: {{code}} - Your Nova Academy login code
login-code.description: Enter this code to continue logging in without a password:
login-code.ignoreNote: If you didn't attempt to log in, you can safely ignore this email.
login-code.validityNote: This code is valid for 20 minutes and can only be used once.

set-password.subject: {code} - Your Nova Academy password verification code
set-password.description: Enter this code to verify your identity and set a new password:
set-password.ignoreNote: If you didn't request a password change, you can safely ignore this email.
set-password.validityNote: This code is valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once.

user-blocked.subject: Your account has been suspended
user-blocked.description: We are writing to inform you that your account on Nova Academy has been suspended by the platform administrator.
